title: Carbon Nanotubes
bookshelves: Category: Technology, Engineering, Agriculture, Industrial processes
summary: Carbon nanotubes, one of carbon allotropes, exhibit remarkable properties and have numerous current and potential applications. Both computational and experimental studies, synthesis, characterization, and applications of carbon nanotubes are unquestionable areas of high interest. Multiple reviews and books have been devoted to various aspects of CNT synthesis, characterization, applications, etc. Our book will be highly attractive and undoubtedly useful for the broad audience of students and researchers interested in the ever-developing area of CNTs, providing them with detailed knowledge of various aspects of this field, its current state-of-the-art, different applications, and perspectives of development.
